# Performance fixtures

`typical-note-seed.md` is the frozen UTF-8 seed for Phase 9 Source, Preview, persistence and
runtime resource measurements. Each benchmark repeats the exact seed and truncates only at a UTF-8
character boundary to obtain 20 KiB, 100 KiB or 1 MiB. Reports record the generated byte size and
SHA-256 so a fixture change is visible rather than silently changing the benchmark.

The fixture is test data only. It is not packaged with StickyMD.
